QuestInfo.name: Dr. Faymus's Request
QuestInfo.1: Nella says that you look much stronger. She wants you to get some ingredients for Dr. Faymus, the owner of the potion shop. He needs #b10 Jr. Necki Skins#k. Taking on Jr. Neckis might be little tough, but you know you can handle it!
QuestInfo.2: You delivered what Dr. Faymus asked for and got bunch of white potions in return. You wonder what kind of potion Dr. Faymus will make using those materials. Return to Nella for another gig.

0.0: You're the one that helped me take care of #b#p1052101##k's request, right? He should be enjoying his seafood soup right about now... But hey, you look much stronger than before! Alright, if that's the case... you can probably take care on some tougher gigs now.
0.1: I have a new job for you, actually. #b#p1051002##k of Famous Pharmacy needs help. He's been working on creating a new potion, and one day, he realized he's out of ingredients. Those are pretty hard to find, and he claims that it's slowing down his experiments...
0.2: He needs the ingredients so that he can continue his research. He needs #b10 #t4000034#s#k... That shouldn't be too difficult. Come see me after you have collected everything. I'll be waiting!

1.0: I knew it... I knew you could get it done quickly! You did your job well last time, and here you are again, taking care of business! Alright, since you have done it so well, I should reward you well. #b#p1051002##k is giving you #b100 #t2000002#s#k to help you in the future.

yes.0: Alright, if you need work sometime down the road, feel free to come back and see me.

item.0: I see you still haven't gathered the materials that #b#p1051002##k requested. You need #b10 #t4000034#s#k in order to conduct the research for a new potion. Just bring everything to me. Good luck!
